summary: Structure Therapeutics filed an 8-K dated September 8, 2026, furnishing (Item 7.01) a press release and investor presentation and reporting (Item 8.01) positive topline clinical results, not a transactional special situation. Disclosures covered Phase 1 SAD data for oral small molecule DACRA ACCG-2671, an amylin receptor agonist dosed in 31 healthy non-obese adults, and 72-week ACCESS open-label extension results for GLP-1 agonist aleniglipron in chronic weight management. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were stated. Risk-arb angle: none; value hinges on clinical execution and financing, not a transaction.
